What is your return policy?
All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them. If an item isn’t the right fit for your space, you can return it completely free of charge, as long as it is sent back in its original packaging.
Here are a few important details regarding returns:
Original Packaging: Please keep all original boxes. If any original packaging is missing, replacement boxes will be needed, which involves a fee of 15% of the value of the items requiring new boxes (up to a maximum of $150), deducted from your refund.
Mattress Trial: Mattresses come with a 100-night trial, and you do not need to keep the original packaging for a mattress return.
Inspection & Refunds: Once our Quality Assurance Team receives and inspects the returned product to confirm there is no customer-caused damage or modifications, your refund will be processed within 3–7 business days.
